beats.anchor: Kaydoudou colle le plâtre contre la caméra.
beats.extras: No secondary characters. Mami Nyanga appears only on the tablet screen.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in a warm home sweater, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, his left forearm in a cast coloured half red and half yellow and covered with dozens of scribbled signatures, one small empty patch near the elbow. BriBri in a plain sweater, his fine shaved part on the left of his head, a braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist. Papa Armand, tall, short neat beard, warm eyes, light blue shirt. On the screen, Mami Nyanga, 68, small and very straight, headscarf and dress in red and yellow wax print, glasses at the tip of her nose.
beats.action: Kaydoudou presses his red and yellow cast right against the tablet camera, grinning with the gap between his front teeth. BriBri leans in beside him, laughing. Papa, behind them, holds the tablet steady against a teapot. On the screen, Mami throws her head back in her immense laugh, and behind her a few hens flap up into the air in a burst of feathers.
beats.location: The small kitchen table of a third floor apartment in Bussy-Saint-Georges on a December evening, a teapot propping up the tablet; on the screen, Mami's sunny courtyard in Bafoussam with bare red earth and an old treadle sewing machine.
beats.light: Warm yellow kitchen lamp on the boys, and the bright dry-season sunshine of Cameroon glowing out of the tablet screen onto their faces.
beats.camera: Medium shot over the table, the tablet screen large in the right half of the frame, the two brothers and Papa on the left half.
beats.alt: Kaydoudou colle son plâtre rouge et jaune contre la tablette, et Mami éclate de rire si fort que ses poules s'envolent derrière elle.

beats.anchor: Tac. Pied gauche. Le ballon claque dans le grillage, pile à gauche.
beats.extras: Kenzo Delattre, 13: slim white boy with brown curls, a grey hooded sweatshirt and very white boots, cheeks red from the cold.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in a winter coat and beanie, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot showing above his sneakers, his left forearm in the cast coloured half red and half yellow with scribbled signatures, holding up a plain red cardboard card with his good hand. BriBri without his coat, in a sweater, his fine shaved part on the left of his head, a braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist. A baguette lies on the bench.
beats.action: Frozen instant in the cage: BriBri has just passed the ball along the frozen ground. Kenzo, eyes flicking over his shoulder like a small bird, has seen the red card that Kaydoudou raises behind his back and strikes the ball first time with his left foot toward the left. Kaydoudou, on tiptoe, card high in the air, shouts with joy. A cloud of breath leaves each mouth.
beats.location: A small fenced mini football pitch of grey concrete behind a white apartment building in Bussy-Saint-Georges, on the frosty morning of 24 December, a metal bench by the fence, bare trees beyond.
beats.light: Cold low winter sun, long shadows, frost glittering on the ground and on the wire fence.
beats.camera: Dynamic low angle from behind the ball, Kenzo's striking foot in the foreground, Kaydoudou and his raised red card behind Kenzo, BriBri on the left.
beats.alt: Dans la cage gelée, Kaydoudou lève une carte rouge dans le dos de Kenzo, qui a regardé avant et frappe du gauche en une touche.

beats.extras: A hospital nurse in her forties: light brown skin, short black hair, pale blue scrubs, putting away a small round electric saw, smiling.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in a sweater with the sleeve pushed up, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, his left forearm pale and thin, freshly out of the cast. BriBri in a winter jacket, his fine shaved part on the left of his head, a braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist.
beats.action: Kaydoudou slowly bends his freed wrist and closes his fingers into a fist, then lifts his eyes to his brother with a new, burning focus in his gaze. BriBri, sitting on the chair next to him, leans forward, moved. On the table, the old cast lies split in two halves like an eggshell, one half red, one half yellow, covered with scribbled signatures.
beats.location: A small, clean hospital treatment room in January, a white table, a window with a pale winter sky.
beats.light: Soft cold winter daylight from the window, a gentle highlight in Kaydoudou's eyes.
beats.camera: Close shot at table height, the two halves of the cast in the foreground, Kaydoudou's fist and eyes sharp in the middle, BriBri slightly out of focus on the side.
beats.alt: Le plâtre gît en deux morceaux sur la table ; Kaydoudou plie son poignet, serre le poing et regarde son frère avec des yeux tout neufs.
